test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **lot**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **A lot **means very often or very much.
 
• It is used as **an adverb**.
 
• It often comes at the **end of a sentence** and never before a noun.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 4 is **option 4**.
